description: KomMod is a framework listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Frameworks", published or maintained by Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems ISE. The initial purpose of KomMod is to support municipalities in planning local energy transitions by calculating cost-optimal, highly resolved, and sector-coupled target energy systems based on local renewable potentials and regional constraints. Coverage: Local/community. Methodical focus: Energy demand, Energy supply, Impacts, Environmental, Appraisal, Integrated approach, Modular build-up, Energy dispatch, Capacity expansion planning, Sector-coupling. Software: AMPL. Initial release: 2014-01-01. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
